subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these bundled action revisions in credential-bearing and repository-mutating workflows once the refreshed exact head passes the affected workflow gates?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but the protected security label and executable action updates cross a supply-chain boundary that requires an explicit human acceptance decision.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Refresh the branch and approve the bundled immutable pins once the relevant security, release, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex workflow checks pass on that SHA.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker, and security-scanning action updates into smaller PRs if maintainers want narrower rollout and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and approve the bundled immutable pins once the relevant security, release, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex workflow checks pass on that SHA.
